experiments.title: Real-Time RT-PCR Viral Load Quantification
experiments.author: Dr. Sarah Chen
experiments.notes: TaqMan probe assay targeting N1 and N2 genes. 40 cycles.
experiments.results: N1 Ct = 22.4, N2 Ct = 23.1. High positive viral amplification confirmed.

experiments.title: Targeted PCR Amplification for Exon 7 Variant
experiments.author: Dr. Anita Rao
experiments.notes: Used samples 0001 and 0002 for PCR test, results attached. 35 cycles amplification at 60°C annealing temperature.
experiments.results: Clear 450 bp band detected on 1.5% agarose gel electrophoresis. Positive confirmation of exon 7 integrity.

experiments.title: RNA Quality & Integrity Assessment (RIN)
experiments.author: Dr. Anita Rao
experiments.notes: RNA sample denatured at 70°C for 2 min before microfluidic chip loading.
experiments.results: RIN score calculated at 9.4. Sharp 18S and 28S ribosomal RNA peaks observed. Approved for RNA-seq library prep.
